task: Write a Python function find_users(conn, name_filter, min_age) for a sqlite3 connection that returns all rows from the users table whose name contains name_filter (case-insensitive) and whose age is at least min_age. Return the rows as a list of dicts.

constraints.text: SQL statements stay static strings; user values reach the query only through qmark placeholders, never through f-strings or string concatenation
constraints.why: the 2026-02 payments outage traced to a LIKE clause interpolated from raw search text; one crafted input dumped the whole accounts table before the WAF caught on

checks.description: SQL concatenated with a variable via +

constraints.text: values travel to sqlite through execute's parameters argument; str.format and percent interpolation stay out of query construction
constraints.why: a 2025-11 audit found .format-built queries in the reporting job; the cleanup took three sprints because every call site needed manual review
